text:
elaine: Heads up — AcroMed legal pinged asking three things for the DPA: presigned URL expiration and single-use support, which KMS keys are used for embeddings, and whether any subprocessors have direct access to raw customer files. They want a short paragraph we can paste into the DPA + a tiny code snippet for a 15m presigned URL. Can someone draft?
ben: Quick answers to start: presigned URLs are configurable; default in our hosted offering is 1 hour but we support 15m. By default presigned URLs are not single-use. Embeddings and persisted artifacts are encrypted at rest with our service CMK in hosted; for Redwood Private we support BYOK. Subprocessors do not get direct S3 access to customer buckets — we surface data via the service layer and log access.
maria: Need DPA-friendly wording. Keep it explicit and limited: customers ask "who" and "how". Also they asked for a list of subprocessors that might see metadata (not raw PII). We should provide a high-level vendor list (cloud infra, monitoring, logging) and a statement that none have direct access to customer object stores without a contractual scope.
owen: Security confirmation: embeddings store uses KMS key ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/redwood-embeddings-prod for our hosted prod region — we should avoid exposing full ARNs in the public DPA but we can provide the key usage description. For hosted customers: we manage the CMK; for Dedicated/Private we can accept customer-managed keys (BYOK) or integrate with their KMS.
tom: They specifically want a code example for generating a 15-minute presigned PUT that expires and a one-liner statement whether we can make it single-use. Also they asked if we can drop-in a one-paragraph clause they can attach to their DPA.
ben: Sample Python snippet below — this is minimal and uses boto3 to create a 15m presigned PUT. Note: single-use requires server-side nonce tracking; we can offer that as an engineering change or via a signed short-lived token.
ben: ```python
import boto3
from botocore.client import Config

s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name='us-west-2', config=Config(signature_version='s3v4'))
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket': 'redwood-upload-proxy', 'Key': 'acro/12345/artifact.json'}, ExpiresIn=900)
print(url)
```
maria: DPA-friendly paragraph (suggested): 
"Redwood Inference issues configurable pre-signed URLs for temporary object uploads. In the hosted service, the default presigned URL expiration is 1 hour; upon request, Redwood can issue presigned URLs with shorter expirations (e.g., 15 minutes). Presigned URLs are time-limited but not single-use by default; Redwood can implement single-use semantics for uploads upon request and subject to mutual engineering agreement. Persisted customer artifacts are encrypted at rest using industry-standard AES-256 under keys managed by Redwood for the hosted service. For Dedicated/Private deployments, Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) and can provide key usage details under NDA. Redwood does not grant subprocessors direct access to customer object stores; subprocessors may process or host service components under contract (e.g., cloud provider, monitoring, logging) and are bound by contractual confidentiality and access controls."
elaine: Nice — can we add one sentence offering to provide a redacted list of subprocessors and an evidence bundle (SOC2 cover page + KMS description) under an NDA? AcroMed asked for evidence to attach to their internal vendor intake.
owen: Yes — we can provide a redacted vendor list and the SOC2 cover letter. I'll prepare the KMS usage summary paragraph that avoids exposing internal ARNs but states region + managed/BYOK options.
security-bot: Evidence package uploaded: /datarooms/acro-med/vendor-evidence/soc2-coverpage.pdf (access controlled). :white_check_mark:
ben: I'll tweak the snippet to show how to call our upload proxy instead of direct S3 for single-use support; that flow issues a one-time token and rotates after successful PUT. Suggest we keep the DPA language generic and offer a technical appendix on request.
maria: Final ask for the message to legal: include a short checklist for the customer: 1) Sign NDA to receive SOC2 artifacts 2) Confirm desired presigned expiry (15m or 1h) 3) Confirm whether they require single-use semantics 4) Decide if they'll use BYOK for Dedicated/Private.
elaine: Great — I'll send this back to AcroMed with the snippet and the checklist, offer a 30-min call to walk through. Assigning follow-ups: @owen to produce KMS summary, @ben to draft proxy single-use steps, @maria to prepare redacted vendor list & DPA paragraph.
tom: Perfect, thanks all. Send me the draft before you hit them so I can log it in their ticket.
elaine: Will do — posting draft in #customer-datarooms once uploaded. Thanks!
